name: Necesse
description: Top-down sandbox survival adventure (Terraria-meets-Zelda). Java dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: World name
variables.description: World save name (created on first start).

variables.label: Memory (MiB)
variables.description: Java heap size for the server (-Xmx).

variables.label: Java binary
variables.description: Java executable for this server. Keep 'java' for the system default (Java 8+ required).

notes: -localdir keeps saves, logs and settings inside the server directory (./saves, ./cfg) so panel backups include them; without it Necesse uses ~/.config/Necesse. The console accepts commands (help, say, stop) — 'stop' saves the world before shutting down. Server settings beyond the launch arguments live in cfg/server.cfg after first start.
